items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Jimmy Ryan's' as a venue ('right next door to Jimmy Ryan's') and clarifies its location, but does not describe a personal or professional relationship with Jimmy Ryan himself.

ctx.x: And we was there... We didn't start sometimes until about 8:30, sometimes nine o'clock, waiting until the people started coming in, you know. Because we'd go until 2:30, sometimes 3 o'clock. Small place. A very good place to play in. The Onyx Club was something like the Three Deuces. It was right side of Jimmy Ryan's, right next door to Jimmy Ryan's -- both of them right together there. And a lot of different musicians from different places; different musicians stopped in at the Onyx Club. We didn't have too much…
I see. Did you ever go to Ryan's and sit in yourself?
